Connecticut Road Conditions/Weather

  • https://cttravelsmart.org/
  • Weather.com

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide
  • Over 13'6" high
  • Trailer over 48' long
  • Over 80,000 lbs.

Special Information Needed

  • Date and time of movement
  • Truck make, license # and state
  • Load info

Times Of Movement

  • 1/2 hour after sunrise to 1/2 hour before sunset; no weekend travel; no travel from 6:30-9am & 4-6pm
  • Loads over 13'6" wide or over 14' high can travel Tuesday thru Thursday 9:00am to 4:00pm
  • No travel New Year’s Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day,Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • Over 14’ high-1 front pilot w/ height pole (route survey if 14’1” high or greater)
  • Route Survey Form
  • Pilot Car Chart

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • Size: Min. 60” wide; max. capacity 1½ ton
  • Signs: Mounted 48” above roadway (min.); 7’x18”; black letters 8” high (min.) on yellow background: “OVERSIZE LOAD FOLLOWING”/”OVERSIZE LOAD AHEAD” preferred
  • Lights: Top mounted flashing or rotating amber lights visible for 1000’
  • Flags: 18” square on front & rear corners of vehicle
  • Additional equipment: 2-way radio communication between escort & load; red hand flag; red vest/jacket
  • Amber light permit required. Apply at MVD.

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • None noted in rules/regulations
  • Dept. of Transportation Permits Office: Hours: 8 am - 4:30 pm ET; M-F
  • Dept. of Transportation
  • 2800 Berlin Turnpike/PO Box 317546
  • Newington, CT 06131-7546
  • (860)594-2880; fax: (860)594-2949
  • https://portal.ct.gov/-/media/DOT/documents/dpermits/Holiday-Restrictions-2021.pdf
